places.quote: Would you object to turn aside into this place—I think it is called Clifford’s Inn—where we can hear one another better
places.note: Inn of Chancery; the characters walk into its garden plantation during the conversation.

places.quote: I happened to be in Chancery Lane this morning, when I saw you going along before me.
places.note: Where Rokesmith first followed Boffin, outside his lawyer's.

places.quote: I lodge at one Mr Wilfer’s, at Holloway.

places.normalized: Boffin's Bower (Harmon's), fictional house in the novel
places.quote: call at the Bower if you like
places.note: Formerly called Harmon's; location not precisely identifiable, reached from Holloway in about a mile.
